counterfactual_missing_items: No final histopathological result was provided; the biopsy was only submitted.
No tooth-like radiopacities or mixed radiodensity are described to support odontoma.
No osteoma-specific growth, cortical, or systemic features are described.
decisive_items: The initial diagnostic hypothesis was maxillary exostosis.
response.rationale: C1 combines the already-supported maxillary exostosis identity with the explicitly supplied anterior maxillary location. R5 is essentially equivalent but omits the anatomical qualifier. R1 and R4 are weaker because the radiopacity and hard mineralized structure are nonspecific without additional osteoma- or odontoma-defining features.

rejected.why: Only nonspecific radiopaque-lesion support is available; there is no evidence uniquely favoring osteoma.
The hard mineralized mass may resemble odontoma, but tooth-like structures or mixed-radiodensity features are not described.
